answer.answer: The two measurements share medium, pH, ionic strength, and temperature, but the measured particle sizes differ substantially (119.5 nm vs 158.1 nm) despite the same 100 nm nominal label, suggesting different particle batches/surface chemistry that likely drive the gap. The difference is 34.0 mV (-48.7 vs -14.7 mV).
